driver_summary: CRITICAL: This charger has been subjected to a V2G session-layer denial-of-service attack. Flood of 15+ SessionSetupReq packets exhausted the connection queue, triggering rate limiting, CPU saturation at 95%, and a forced watchdog restart. Do not connect your vehicle — the charger communication module is unstable and may not authenticate sessions correctly.
